justifications.durability: the behaviour is pinned by test_scanner_failures_reach_stage_receipt parametrized over scan_only for both failure modes, test_stage_without_return_preserves_receipt_errors for the receipt-merge path, and test_receipt_errors_fail_stage_and_skip_consumers asserting FAILED, reason content, cost retention and dependent-skip; the mutation negative control shows those assertions fire when the guard is removed, and the same test passes at head.
justifications.evidence: I re-ran the full gate at head 777739b74bb79512588e7c2731e1d073d7c95bd6 and got 89 passed, EXIT=0 (independent_head_gate.log), matching the run's head-gate.log, and I independently reproduced the negative control by mutating a scratch copy of sequence.py so the runner ignores receipt errors: test_receipt_errors_fail_stage_and_skip_consumers then fails 'ran' == 'failed', EXIT=1 (independent_negative_control.log), while it passes at the unmutated head. The shortfall is the base arm: the manifest and classification record baseline_suite null, and both base-revision logs were taken on a dirty tree (they collect a test file added only at head) without PYTHONPATH, so no clean pre-change full-suite arm exists; the zero-added-failure conclusion still holds because both arms are green.
justifications.fit: one conventional fix(discover) commit whose body states the mechanism (record failures by source, treat nonempty receipt errors as a failed stage, retain cost); no plan, section, ticket or version identifiers appear in the subject, body, the added symbol scanner_errors, or the new test module name test_signals_scan_errors.py.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the three done-when witnesses the plan names are all present and verified at head: a returned stats error and a raised non-infrastructure error both reach the receipt keyed by scanner, and a nonempty receipt makes the runner mark signals failed and skip candidates; the plan's 'generic receipt rule' is implemented in the runner, not special-cased to signals (parallel.py:2903/2986, sequence.py:728-739).
justifications.reuse: the change extends the existing receipt mechanism and DataDiscoveryState rather than adding a parallel path: scanner_errors is a new field on the same state object that already accumulates scan stats, the errors mapping flows through the existing _run_with_receipt merge and the existing FAILED/dependency-skip branch, so the generic rule reuses the raise path's skipping and cost accounting.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 407614bf..777739b lists only the four declared source/test paths with no unrelated reformatting; the only declaration shortfall is the plan-declared evidence fragment, which was not produced (the prompt waives evidence prose, so this is a plan-versus-prompt declaration mismatch rather than a worker omission).
